04 · AI APPLIED TO DEVELOPMENT

Before the code,
a good specification.

I use SDD — Spec-Driven Development — with OpenSpec to structure changes: proposals, delta specs, design and tasks. Claude Code and Codex work with versioned context, verifiable requirements and acceptance criteria.

Breaking work into tasks and loading only relevant specifications helps me keep context focused and avoid repeating lengthy instructions. This can reduce token usage and back-and-forth with AI. Recorded decisions and clear acceptance criteria also help reduce rework, resume sessions and check that the implementation meets the agreed requirements.

Claude Code and CodexSDDOpenSpecDelta specsCode reviewValidation
SPEC → CODE → REVIEWWORKFLOW
  1. 01

    Specify

    OpenSpec: proposals define scope and motivation; delta specs describe requirements and acceptance scenarios.

  2. 02

    Implement with context

    Design records technical decisions; tasks break down implementation for Claude Code and Codex while maintaining traceability to the specification.

  3. 03

    Review and validate

    Verify implementation, tests and scenarios; synchronize changes with the specs and archive the completed proposal.

proposal → specs → design → tasks → verify → archive ↻

06 · GET TO KNOW ME

A little more,
before we talk.

Quick answers about my experience and how I develop software.

How do you introduce yourself in 30 seconds?

I'm Vinícius, a senior fullstack developer based in São Paulo. My career began in data and evolved into .NET APIs, React and Vue interfaces, and integrations. I also work with Kafka, webhooks and AI-assisted development using Claude Code and Codex and SDD.

Where do Kafka and webhooks fit in?

In system integration: Kafka for messaging and event-driven workflows; webhooks to communicate events between applications. These skills complement my work with APIs and services.

How do you use AI in development?

With Claude Code and Codex, SDD and OpenSpec: I start with proposals, specs, design and tasks, define scenarios and acceptance criteria, and use AI to support implementation. Code review and behavior validation are part of the process.

What is your education and English level?

I hold a degree in Systems Analysis and Development from Centro Universitário Senac, completed in 2019. I have advanced English proficiency. My Azure certification and course credentials are available on this page.
